cross_partition_check_split_v1.interpretation: Under the frozen rule, split v1 is not free of cross-partition similarity groups. Whether these groups are the same animal is not established: the human review has not been done. The number 771 must not be reported as confirmed identity leakage.

chain_analysis.source: identity_v2_20261106/crossing_groups_summary.csv (86 rows, one per crossing group, priority order: groups touching test first, then size, weak bridges, links near the threshold)
chain_analysis.weak_bridge_definition: an automatic link with similarity < 0.92 whose removal splits the group into two parts of at least two images each
chain_analysis.observation: The large groups are transitive chains inside visually homogeneous breeds and contain many evidently different animals; the strongest candidates for genuine repeat appearances are the small groups and two-image pairs with similarity near 0.95 (for example great_pyrenees_101 / great_pyrenees_102, similarity 0.956). This observation is a reading of two contact sheets by the project assistant, not a review verdict; no verdict has been recorded.

sensitivity_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic only. The frozen threshold stays 0.90; no threshold was chosen from model accuracy or from the test split.

split_v2_proposal.status: PROPOSAL, NOT APPROVED. Produced by the Phase 1 splitter (fractions 0.70/0.15/0.15, seed 42) over the 6,541 similarity groups. No training or evaluation has used it.
split_v2_proposal.drift_explanation: The splitter assigns whole groups. The 13 chain groups with 10 or more images (574 images) landed 363 in val and 211 in train, which inflates val to 18.8 percent and skews val towards dogs (73 percent vs 68 percent overall). Breaking the chains through the human pair review is expected to reduce this drift; changing the threshold to fit the fractions is not permitted by the protocol.
